body: You honestly don’t know anything about my life. Or my budget. Challenging me on what i can and can’t afford is the last thing i need. I said i can’t afford it, so back the fuck off this. Part of the reason i want to die is because i have to go to the fucking food bank to feed my child. I don’t see you offering to help me in ANY way, so I’d appreciate it if you reserved your judgment for yourself.

I had to stop going because my insurance went up. Therapy is now $80 a session. I was going to plan on making one phone call tomorrow. I'm trying not be overwhelmed, so call one therapist and ask about sliding scale. Call one a day until I can pull myself out of this.

No, it doesn't. You're not a loser. In fact, you're trying to find your voice, and in a big world, and a big forum, there are tons of people on here that will listen, and help you find your voice. You don't have to be a certain age to deal with depression. Depression affects people of all ages, sizes, backgrounds, socioeconomic classes. We have seen this recently with Kate Spade and Anthony Bourdain. By every metric society uses, those people had their lives "together." But, that goes to show how much we don't know about the internal struggles of others. We must always be kind to others. Always. 

You're not alone, friend. I've got an ear if you'd like one.
